'''Min Enze''' ({{lang-zh|s=闵恩泽|t=閔恩澤|p=Mǐn Ēnzé}}; 4 February 1924 – 7 March 2016) was a Chinese chemical engineer and chemist. He was an expert in petrochemical catalysis, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS) and the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] (CAE).

==Biography==
Min was born in [[Chengdu]], [[Sichuan]], China. He graduated from [[National Central University]] ([[Nanjing University]]) in 1946, majoring in chemical engineering.<ref>National Central University was renamed Nanjing University in 1949 and reinstated in Taiwan in 1962. The chemical engineering department became part of Nanjing Institute of Technology ([[Southeast University]]) in 1952, and then [[Nanjing University of Technology]] in 1958.</ref>

In 1951, Min obtained his doctor's degree from [[Ohio State University]] in the United States. He worked for [[Nalco Holding Company|National Aluminate Corporation]] between 1951 and 1955.<ref>{{cite news|title=闵恩泽的爱国之路|url=http://scitech.people.com.cn/n/2014/0425/c1057-24942169.html|access-date=8 March 2016|publisher=Chinese Sciences News|date=25 April 2014|language=zh}}</ref> He returned to China in August 1955 after the [[Korean War]] ended and was assigned work at Beijing Institute of Oil Refining (now Institute of Petrochemical Science of [[China Petroleum and Chemical Corporation]]). Min was elected an academician of CAS in 1980, a member of [[Third World Academy of Sciences]] (TWAS) in 1993, and an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering in 1994. He served as the chairman of academic committee of the Institute of Petrochemical Science of China Petroleum and Chemical Corporation ([[Sinopec]]).

Min received the [[Highest Science and Technology Award]] in 2007, the most prestigious scientific prize awarded in China.

Min died on 7 March 2016 at the age of 92 in Beijing.<ref>{{cite news|title=我国炼油催化应用科学奠基者闵恩泽院士逝世|url=https://www.cas.cn/cm/201603/t20160308_4545501.shtml|access-date=8 March 2016|publisher=[[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]|date=8 March 2016|language=zh}}</ref>

[[Asteroid]] [[30991 Minenze]] is named in his honor.<ref>{{cite news|title=中国四位国家最高科技奖得主获小行星命名|url=http://www.chinanews.com/gn/2011/05-03/3013677.shtml|publisher=chinanews|date=3 May 2011|language=zh}}</ref>
